reflections.summary: Game 3 was lost because the intended Hatterene Trick Room opening never came online: Waterfall flinched Hatterene through the Fake Out on Pelipper, then Manectric was immediately removed by a critical-hit Waterfall on its switch-in. That left the team without speed control or its main electric pressure while Mega Swampert and rain remained active. Mega Floette correctly removed Pelipper, but Hatterene then fell to Choice Scarf Adaptability Basculegion's Last Respects and Floette could not survive the final Swampert+Basculegion pressure. The Hatterene/Scrafty/Manectric/Floette bring had a coherent anti-rain concept—Fake Out, Intimidate, Trick Room, Lightning Rod, and Floette's Grass coverage—but it was fragile into immediate Waterfall pressure and Basculegion's late-game cleanup. Mega Floette was the appropriate Mega choice because Energy Ball threatened the revealed Mega Swampert; no supplied evidence establishes that the between-game adjustments themselves helped or backfired, beyond this Game 3 plan failing to convert. The registered six do not show a clearly proven materially better four from the supplied evidence: Talonflame is unattractive into rain, while no sets or matchup evidence support claiming Hatterene, Hisuian Goodra, or another alternative would definitely have solved the matchup.
reflections.adjustment: For a future series, treat Mega Swampert's Waterfall flinch pressure as a major obstacle to a Hatterene-led Trick Room line rather than assuming Fake Out on Pelipper makes Trick Room safe. Preserve Mega Floette for the Swampert/Basculegion endgame whenever possible; once Swampert is at the confirmed 77% range, seriously consider Energy Ball to remove it instead of spending Floette's attack on Pelipper if that line leaves Floette exposed to Basculegion afterward. Do not rely on Manectric as the primary answer to this rain core when the revealed attackers can simply use Waterfall, Hurricane, and Ground coverage; bring it only if its broader utility is needed. Build the four around a more resilient answer to repeated physical Waterfall plus a plan to prevent or absorb Basculegion's Last Respects, while retaining Scrafty's Intimidate/Fake Out utility if a safer speed-control line exists.
reflections.notebook: Opponent's confirmed rain core is Damp Rock Pelipper with Drizzle, Hurricane, Hydro Pump, Protect, and Tailwind plus Adamant Mega Swampert with Waterfall, Earthquake, Ice Punch, and Protect. Swampert repeatedly chose Waterfall and its flinch chance can deny Hatterene's Trick Room even when Pelipper is Fake Outed. Choice Scarf Adaptability Basculegion revealed Last Respects, Wave Crash, Flip Turn, and Aqua Jet; after using Last Respects it is choice-locked into that move, but it remains a dangerous late-game cleaner once partners have fainted. Mega Floette's Energy Ball is confirmed to KO Mega Swampert from 77%, so Floette should be conserved for that assignment when viable. Possible additional options shown are Focus Sash Prankster Whimsicott with Tailwind/Encore, Leftovers Primarina with Calm Mind, and Mega Ampharos; these were not confirmed as Game 3 selections. Prep conclusion: respect both Tailwind and Trick Room denial, avoid a single fragile Hatterene-based speed-control plan, and prioritize a durable route through Waterfall pressure before exposing Floette to Basculegion.

reflections.summary: We won Game 3 and the series 2-1 by leveraging Pelipper's Drizzle to set rain, enabling Mega Swampert's Swift Swim speed control and offensive pressure to dismantle the opponent's Trick Room and offensive pivots. Bringing Basculegion as a clean-up threat sealed the game after key opponent Pokémon like Hatterene and Floette-Mega fell.
reflections.adjustment: No major adjustments needed since the series was won, but keeping Basculegion and rain-setters prioritized against similar Trick Room / Fairy-heavy cores remains optimal.
reflections.notebook: Opponent runs Hatterene, Scrafty, Manectric, and Floette-Mega. Hatterene relies on Trick Room and Protect, while Scrafty provides Fake Out and Intimidate support. Rain-boosted Mega Swampert and Choice Scarf Basculegion effectively break down this core.
